title: The Secret of the Flame Tree
summary: A lady is found at the bottom of a cliff, seemingly having committed suicide. Everyone else was at the event when it happened.
method: The killer played a prerecorded speech to establish her alibi, then snuck out and killed the victim.
motive: Her employer was at risk of being exposed as a plagiarist and she didn't want to be out of a job.
killer: The lady making a speech at the event.
